page_title: LAZ 1-1 UDI | Lazio v Udinese 10/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Martin Payero (Udinese) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

90+5' Arthur Atta (Udinese) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball goes behind for a corner. Udinese will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+1' Today's referee Marco Piccinini rightly decides to book Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) for his harsh tackle.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kingsley Ehizibue trots off the pitch and is replaced by Rui Modesto (Udinese).
86' Martin Payero (Udinese) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
81' Marco Baroni prepares a substitution. Gustav Isaksen is replaced by Patric (Lazio).
81' Substitution. Florian Thauvin makes way for Keinan Davis (Udinese).
80' Adam Marusic (Lazio) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
76' Marco Piccinini shows the yellow card to Martin Payero (Udinese) for a heavy challenge.
76' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

76' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top right corner only for Ivan Provedel to dive and make a save. The referee signals a corner kick to Udinese.
76' It seemed like Jordan Zemura (Udinese) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
75' Adam Marusic (Lazio) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for a foul. Udinese are awarded a free kick.
73' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) is adjudged offside.
73' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

69' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
65' Substitution. Jordan Zemura (Udinese) has come on for Sandi Lovric.
65' Substitution. Arthur Atta (Udinese) replaces Hassane Kamara.
65' Kosta Runjaic has decided to make a change. Martin Payero (Udinese) replaces Jurgen Ekkelenkamp.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pedro (Lazio) is coming onto the pitch as Boulaye Dia cannot continue after picking up an injury.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matias Vecino departs the field of play to be replaced by Reda Belahyane (Lazio).
64' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
62' A yellow card for a tackle by Manuel Lazzari (Lazio). Marco Piccinini doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
60' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
60' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) sees a yellow card from Marco Piccinini after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
59' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
59' The corner from Sandi Lovric (Udinese) is hurriedly cleared. The linesman points to the corner flag, Udinese are going to take it.
57' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
55' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
55' What a big chance! Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
52' Marco Piccinini shows a yellow card to Matias Vecino (Lazio), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
52' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Marco Piccinini saw the whole situation. Udinese get a free kick.
49' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
47' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
46' Half-time substitution. Marco Baroni decided to make a change. Loum Tchaouna is replaced by Tijjani Noslin (Lazio).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Marco Piccinini has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Ivan Provedel, who smothers the ball.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Marco Piccinini blows for a foul after Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. There is a free kick near the sideline to Lazio.
44' What a big chance! Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
42' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) commits a rough challenge and Marco Piccinini blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Udinese, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
39' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Maduka Okoye.
35' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Lazio players have a reason to celebrate!
34' The Lazio players halt their celebrations as referee Marco Piccinini makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
32' 1 - 1 Goal! Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:1.
32' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
31' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Maduka Okoye makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!

30' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
27' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.

22' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Florian Thauvin (Udinese) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the middle of the target. The assist goes to Lorenzo Lucca and the score changes to 0:1.
22' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
22' That's a well-taken pass by Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
22' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.

21' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Ivan Provedel has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
19' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
15' Matias Vecino (Lazio) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Marco Piccinini blows for a foul.
13' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Florian Thauvin (Udinese). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
13' Matias Vecino (Lazio) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Marco Piccinini no option but to blow his whistle.
8' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Marco Piccinini didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
5' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
4' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) takes the corner but it's cleared.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Udinese will have the kick-off.
Marco Piccinini will referee today's match.
